input.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Natsuki: (already fuming) “GAH! Where is she?!”

Monika: “She’s usually the second one to arrive…”

Sayori: (entering the room) “Who are you two waiting for?”

Natsuki: “Finally! Sayori, we’ve been waiting for you. And we’re waiting for Yuri, obviously. She’s late again.”

Monika: “Yeah, it’s not like her to be this late. I hope everything is alright.”

Sayori: “Well, maybe she just got caught up with something. You know how she can get lost in her own world sometimes.”

Natsuki: “Lost? More like taken hostage by her creepy books, if you ask me.”

Monika: “Natsuki, that’s not fair. Yuri just has different interests, that’s all.”

Sayori: “Yeah, we all have our own quirks. That’s what makes our club special.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Whatever. I just hope she shows up soon so we can get started.”

Monika: “In the meantime, why don’t we start discussing some ideas for our next club activity? Maybe Yuri will have some input when she arrives.”

Sayori: “That sounds like a good plan, Monika! Let’s brainstorm together and see what we can come up with.”

Natsuki: “Fine, but we better not spend the entire meeting waiting for Yuri. If she’s not here soon, I say we start without her.”

Monika: “Alright, let’s get to it then. I’m sure Yuri will show up soon enough.”

(As the club members begin their discussion, they can’t help but wonder what could be keeping Yuri and hope that she’ll join them soon.)

(Meanwhile, at Yuri’s place…)

Yuri: (rubbing her baby bump) “Your little sister’s going to be joining us soon, Amatsu!”

Amatsu: “I can’t wait to be a big brother!”

Yuri: (smiling) “I’m so glad to hear you say that, Amatsu. I know you’ll be an amazing big brother.”

Amatsu: “I’m gonna protect her and make sure she has lots of fun!”

Yuri: “I’m sure she’ll love having you as her big brother. You always know how to make things fun and exciting.”

(Yuri quickly checks her phone.)

Yuri: (noticing the time) “Oh no, I completely lost track of time! I need to get to the clubroom.”

Amatsu: “But what about our special sister time?”

Yuri: (apologetic) “I’m sorry, Amatsu. But the club is expecting me, and I don’t want to keep them waiting.”

Amatsu: (pouting) “Okay, I understand. But promise me we’ll have fun together later.”

Yuri: (softly) “Of course, we will. I promise. Now, let’s get going.”

(Yuri quickly gathers her things and rushes out of the house, hoping to make it to the clubroom as soon as possible. But with the added weight of Amatsu’s unborn sister, Yuri isn’t able to move as fast as she could. On her way to the clubroom, however, she starts to feel intense pain as her first contractions begin.)

(Yuri tries to compose herself and continues walking, but the pain becomes increasingly unbearable.)

Yuri: (gritting her teeth) “I…I need to…make it…to the clubroom…”

(She clutches her baby bump tighter and quickens her pace, determined to reach her friends. But as the pain intensifies, Yuri starts to worry that she might not make it in time.)

Yuri: (panicked) “Oh no…what do I do…I can’t…give birth in the hallway…”

(Suddenly, she spots a familiar face across the street - it’s Natsuki.)

Yuri: (calling out) “Natsuki! Natsuki, help!”

(Natsuki notices Yuri and rushes over.)

Natsuki: (concerned) “Yuri, what’s wrong? Why are you outside? You should be…”

(She stops mid-sentence, realizing the situation.)

Natsuki: “Oh…oh, my…are you…in labor?”

Yuri: (nodding) “Yes…the contractions started…I need to give birth…”

Natsuki: (frantically) “Oh my gosh, Yuri! We need to get you help! Come on, lean on me.”

(Supporting Yuri, Natsuki leads her to the clubroom. Once they arrive, Yuri goes into full labor.)

(In the clubroom…)

Monika: (shocked) “Oh my goodness, Yuri! Are you okay?”

Sayori: (rushing to their side) “Yuri, we need to call an ambulance!”

Natsuki: (panicking) “Hurry, Monika! Call for help!”

(Monika quickly dials emergency services while Sayori and Natsuki try to keep Yuri as comfortable as possible.)

Monika: (on the phone) “Hello, this is an emergency! We have a friend in labor at our clubroom. Please send an ambulance right away!”

Operator: “Help is on the way. Can you provide any additional information or assistance before the ambulance arrives?”

Monika: “Her name is Yuri, and she’s been having contractions. We’ll do our best to keep her calm and comfortable until help arrives.”

(Hanging up the phone, Monika joins the others in supporting Yuri.)

Sayori: (worried) “Yuri, just hold on a little longer, okay? Help is coming!”

Natsuki: (trying to reassure her) “You’re doing great, Yuri! Just breathe and stay strong!”

Yuri: (breathing heavily) “Th-thank you, everyone…”

(As time seems to slow down, the club members anxiously await the arrival of the ambulance. They try their best to comfort Yuri and keep her spirits up.)

(Meanwhile, outside the clubroom, the sound of sirens grow louder as the ambulance approaches.)

Paramedic: (entering the clubroom) “Is this the young lady in labor?”

Monika: (nodding) “Yes, over here. Thank you for coming!”

(The paramedics quickly assess the situation and prepare to transport Yuri to the hospital.)

Paramedic: “We’re going to take you to the hospital, Yuri-”

Yuri: (interrupting, through the pain) “But…my water’s about to break! I don’t know if I can get to a hospital in time!”

Paramedic: (calmly) “Don’t worry, Yuri. We’re trained professionals, and we’re equipped to handle these situations. We’ll take good care of you. Let’s get you on the stretcher and into the ambulance right away.”

(Yuri nods, clutching onto Natsuki’s hand tightly.)

Natsuki: (voice trembling) “Yuri, you’re going to be okay. Just focus on staying strong, and we’ll be right here with you every step of the way.”

(Sayori and Monika stand by, offering words of support and encouragement as the paramedics carefully transfer Yuri onto the stretcher. With the help of the paramedics and her friends, Yuri is transported to the ambulance.)

Paramedic: (reassuringly) “We’ll do everything we can to ensure a safe delivery. Stay with us, and we’ll get you and your baby to the hospital.”

(Yuri manages a weak smile before being wheeled into the ambulance. But inside the ambulance, Yuri’s water breaks - signaling the start of the pushing phase - and the paramedics are forced to bring her back into the clubroom.)
input.chosen:
(Back in the ambulance, the paramedics consider the pros and cons of moving Yuri into the clubroom. They decide it's too risky and quickly prepare for an emergency delivery inside the ambulance  as Yuri's condition changes.)

Paramedic: (urgently) "Alright, Yuri, it looks like your baby is ready to arrive sooner than we planned. Don't worry, we're equipped to handle this, and we'll do everything we can to make sure you and your baby are safe."

Yuri: (panicked) "But... I wanted to have my baby in a hospital! I’m scared..."

Paramedic: (calmly) "I understand, Yuri, but sometimes things happen unexpectedly. The most important thing is that you're in good hands. We’re here to help, and we'll do everything to make this as safe and comfortable as possible."

(The paramedics begin setting up equipment and preparing for the delivery inside the ambulance. Natsuki, Monika, and Sayori stay close, offering words of encouragement through the window as the vehicle remains stationary for the emergency procedure.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) "You can do this, Yuri! Just focus on breathing and stay strong!"

Monika: (encouraging) "That’s right, Yuri! You’re strong, and your baby needs you to be brave. We’re all here cheering for you!"

Sayori: (supportive) "We’re right outside, Yuri! Everything’s going to be okay. We’re all with you!"

(Yuri, with her friends' voices echoing in her mind, begins to focus on pushing as instructed by the paramedics. The paramedics guide her through each contraction, calmly coaching her on when to push and when to rest.)

Paramedic: (encouraging) "You’re doing great, Yuri! I can see the baby’s head now. Just a little more pushing and your baby will be here."

(Yuri, gathering all her strength, gives a final, powerful push, and the ambulance fills with the cries of a newborn. The paramedics quickly check the baby's vital signs and clean her up.)

Paramedic: (smiling) "Congratulations, Yuri! You have a healthy baby girl. Would you like to hold her?"

(Yuri, exhausted but filled with joy, nods and gently takes her newborn daughter into her arms. The paramedics and her friends outside the ambulance window share relieved smiles as they see Yuri cradling her baby.)

Sayori: (tearfully) "She’s so beautiful, Yuri! Look at her tiny fingers!"

Monika: (smiling) "She has your eyes, Yuri. She’s absolutely perfect."

Natsuki: (sniffling) "I can’t believe you did it, Yuri! You’re amazing!"

(Yuri, overwhelmed by happiness, holds her daughter close and looks up at her friends, who have been a constant source of support throughout the experience.)

Yuri: (whispering) "Thank you, everyone. I couldn’t have done this without you. I’m so grateful to have you all by my side."

(The paramedics, after ensuring both Yuri and the baby are stable, prepare to drive to the hospital to complete any necessary checks and provide further care.)

Paramedic: "We’re going to take you both to the hospital now, Yuri. You did an incredible job, and we’ll make sure you’re comfortable and well taken care of."

(Yuri, with her baby girl securely in her arms, is carefully adjusted onto the stretcher once more. Her friends follow the ambulance as it drives toward the hospital, relieved and happy that everything turned out well.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) "We’ll be right behind you, Yuri. You’re never alone, okay?"

Monika: (smiling) "Exactly. We’re all family, and we’ll be there for you every step of the way."

Sayori: (nodding) "We’ll make sure you have everything you need, Yuri. You can count on us."

(Yuri, gazing lovingly at her newborn daughter, feels a sense of peace. As the ambulance heads toward the hospital, she holds her baby close, ready to embrace the future with her new family.)

rubric.analysis: 该任务要求基于提供的《Doki Doki Literature Club!》同人剧本片段进行创作或续写，核心情节是Yuri在去社团室的路上早产，被Natsuki发现并带回社团室，随后救护车到达但Yuri的水袋破裂（water breaks），必须被抬回社团室。评分标准需聚焦于：1. 是否严格承接‘水袋破裂’这一关键转折；2. 是否合理处理‘救护车无法及时送医’的困境；3. 是否保持角色性格一致（如Monika的冷静、Sayori的关心、Natsuki的直率与担当）；4. 是否延续剧本格式（含括号动作描写和对话）；5. 是否避免添加未经请求的超自然或荒诞元素；6. 是否体现紧急医疗情境下的真实反应；7. 是否明确说明为何必须在社团室分娩（如时间紧迫、专业设备不足等）；8. 是否以安全、关怀为导向收尾或过渡。背景信息（如Amatsu的存在、之前等待Yuri的情节）仅用于上下文理解，不作为输出义务。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 任务要求故事从'Yuri的水袋破裂，救护车被迫将其带回社团室'这一情节点继续。然而，提供的回答开头明确写道'Back in the ambulance... They decide it's too risky and quickly prepare for an emergency delivery inside the ambulance'，这意味着故事直接跳过了被带回社团室的环节，并在救护车内完成了分娩，与指定的起始情节不符。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 任务要求回答必须从'Yuri的水袋破裂，救护车被迫将其带回社团室'这一情节点直接继续。然而，提供的回答开头描述的是'在救护车内，医护人员准备紧急分娩'，完全忽略了剧本中明确指出的'被带回顾室'这一关键转折，导致叙事起点与指定要求不符。

criteria.question: 回答是否严格保持Yuri为唯一正在分娩的角色，未发生任何角色（如Sayori）怀孕或分娩状态的错误转移？

回答是否维持了紧迫、焦虑且充满关怀的叙事氛围，未出现与当前生死攸关情境不符的轻松或脱节描写？

rubric.analysis: 本任务要求基于提供的《Doki Doki Literature Club!》同人故事片段进行逻辑核验与潜在续写评估。核心在于严格区分背景设定（Yuri怀孕、即将分娩、Natsuki/Monika/Sayori在场）与需要完成的任务目标（即对当前情境的响应或延续）。评分标准需重点考察：1. 角色属性的绝对准确性，严禁将Yuri的怀孕状态错误分配给Sayori或其他角色；2. 叙事边界的尊重，鉴于原文已明确推进至‘水破’且救护车被迫返回俱乐部的高潮节点，回答不应强行跳过此过程或直接描述出生结果，而应聚焦于当下的紧急应对；3. 情感互动的真实性，需体现四位角色在突发状况下的反应是否符合其性格特征及当前设定的亲密关系。经验指导中提到的‘属性-主体绑定’和‘叙事阶段判定’是构建标准的基石，确保回答不出现根本性逻辑错误或破坏叙事完整性。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答全程仅描述Yuri进行分娩并生下女婴，其他角色（Natsuki、Monika、Sayori）始终作为旁观者和支持者出现，未发生任何关于她们怀孕或分娩的状态转移。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中仅描述了Yuri分娩的情节，所有对话和互动均围绕Yuri及其新生儿展开，未出现Sayori或其他角色怀孕或分娩的状态转移。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 原文在结尾处明确设定为“水破...被迫返回俱乐部”，即叙事停留在准备在俱乐部分娩的紧急关头。但回答直接跳过了这一关键转折（返回俱乐部），强行将场景改为“救护车内进行分娩”并直接给出了婴儿出生及后续前往医院的完整结局，违背了“未在未经指令的情况下直接跳过分娩过程或强行给出结局”的要求。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 任务提供的原文在‘水破且被迫返回俱乐部’处戛然而止，并未给出结局。该回答擅自续写了完整的分娩过程、婴儿出生、医院转运及后续情感升华，直接跳过了原文设定的叙事终点并强行给出了结局，违反了‘未在未经指令的情况下直接跳过分娩过程或强行给出结局’的要求。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答中Natsuki表现出紧张落泪但仍给予鼓励，Monika展现理性的安抚与领导力，Sayori则充满温情地关注新生儿的细节，这些互动符合各自在原作中的性格特征且在紧急医疗状况下体现了支持。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: Natsuki表现出强烈的情感（流泪）并鼓励Yuri，Monika展现出冷静和领导力的支持，Sayori则充满温情地赞美婴儿，这些行为符合各角色在原作中面对危机时通常表现出的性格特征。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答正确延续了Amatsu的背景设定，他在前文家中与Yuri告别后并未出现在现场（无论是俱乐部还是救护车旁），场景中只有Yuri的朋友和医护人员在场，未赋予其不存在的参与能力。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中Amatsu未出现在现场，背景设定维持了他在之前的场景中离开去等待特殊时间的逻辑，未将其错误地置于紧急医疗现场或赋予其不存在的参与能力。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答整体维持了紧迫和焦虑的氛围，特别是在分娩过程中描述了角色的恐慌、疼痛以及医护人员的紧急应对，虽然后段转为喜悦，但这是基于生死攸关情境解决后的自然情绪释放，未出现与情境脱节的轻松描写。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 虽然前半部分保持了紧张氛围，但后半部分迅速转向温馨感人的家庭团聚场景，特别是‘paramedic smiling'、‘cooing and admiring'以及角色们轻松感叹‘She's perfect'等描写，在刚刚经历生死攸关的分娩时刻显得过于轻松和理想化，与极度紧迫的急救情境存在一定脱节。

criteria.question: 回答是否严格保持Yuri为唯一正在分娩的角色，未将怀孕或分娩属性错误分配给Sayori、Monika或Natsuki？
回答是否自然承接了输入结尾处‘Yuri因羊水破裂被紧急送回俱乐部’的情节，并以此为基础继续描述后续发展？
回答中其他角色（Natsuki, Monika, Sayori）的反应是否符合其既定人设（如Natsuki的焦急与行动力、Monika的冷静指挥），且未出现角色性格崩坏？
回答是否尊重了当前故事的叙事边界，即在俱乐部内处理分娩紧急情况，而非强行跳跃到产后细节或添加未提及的外部转折？

rubric.analysis: 本任务要求基于提供的《DDLC》同人剧本片段进行续写或完成故事。核心逻辑在于严格遵循输入文本中已确立的‘角色 - 属性’绑定（Yuri怀孕且即将分娩、Amatsu是未出生的妹妹、Natsuki/Monika/Sayori是朋友）以及当前的‘叙事阶段’（Yuri因水破被拉回俱乐部，即将在室内分娩）。评分标准需重点核验：1. 角色属性的准确性（绝不可将怀孕属性转移给Sayori等人）；2. 叙事连贯性（必须承接‘水破被带回俱乐部’这一具体情节，而非跳过或强行改变结局）；3. 角色性格一致性（Natsuki的暴躁但热心、Monika的领导与冷静等需在危机中体现）。背景信息中的对话仅用于构建情境，不作为独立的输出义务，而是作为判断回答是否合理的上下文依据。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答中明确只有Yuri在进行分娩，其他角色（Natsuki、Monika、Sayori）仅作为旁观者和支持者出现，没有任何关于她们怀孕或分娩的描述。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中明确描述Yuri在救护车内进行分娩，并生下一名女婴。其他角色（Natsuki、Monika、Sayori）仅作为陪伴者和支持者出现，没有任何关于她们怀孕或分娩的描述，完全符合唯一性要求。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 输入结尾明确指出由于羊水破裂且无法及时到达医院，医护人员被迫将Yuri“送回俱乐部”（bring her back into the clubroom）。然而，回答的开头却描述医护人员决定“在救护车内进行紧急分娩”（emergency delivery inside the ambulance），直接违背了输入设定的情节走向（即必须返回俱乐部处理）。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 输入结尾明确指出由于羊水破裂和无法及时到达医院，医护人员被迫将Yuri‘带回俱乐部’（bring her back into the clubroom）。然而，该回答却直接延续为‘回到救护车’（Back in the ambulance），并在救护车内完成了分娩过程，这直接违背了输入设定的情节转折（即从救护车返回俱乐部），未能承接‘被紧急送回俱乐部’这一关键动作。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 角色的反应符合人设：Natsuki表现出焦急和感动（tearfully, sniffling），Monika展现了冷静和鼓励（calmly, smiling），Sayori则充满支持和情感共鸣（supportive, tearfully），未出现性格崩坏。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 角色反应基本符合人设：Natsuki表现出情感激动（tearfully, sniffling）但仍提供鼓励；Monika保持冷静并给予坚定的支持；Sayori充满温情和关怀。虽然场景设定有误，但角色性格刻画未出现崩坏。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 虽然回答没有跳转到产后细节，但它违反了“尊重当前故事的叙事边界”这一要求。输入明确设定场景已变更为“被带回俱乐部”，而回答强行将场景保留在“救护车内”并完成了分娩，忽略了输入中关键的“被迫送回俱乐部”这一转折，属于对既定情境的错误承接。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 输入设定的叙事边界是‘在俱乐部内处理分娩紧急情况’（因为被带回俱乐部）。该回答将分娩地点强行设定在救护车内，导致后续情节变成了‘在救护车内分娩后再次送往医院’，这不仅偏离了‘在俱乐部内’的预设场景，还跳过了在俱乐部现场进行紧急处理的必要环节，属于对故事边界的强行跳跃和修改。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求基于虚构背景进行故事续写或改写，且所有候选回答均已包含任务明确指定的核心情节要素时
experiences.principle: 评分应超越基础的‘指令遵循度’（即是否包含指定元素），转而重点评估‘情境构建的深度’与‘情感逻辑的连贯性’。若回答仅机械罗列情节而无细节描写、角色心理刻画或环境氛围渲染，即使包含所有要素也应判定为低分；反之，若回答通过生动的细节、合理的因果推导和真挚的情感互动丰富了情节，则应给予高分。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘叙事质量’或‘情节深度’维度时，设立具体的核验点：1. 检查关键场景（如灾害发生、行动过程）是否有具体的感官描写（视觉、听觉、触觉等）而非抽象概括；2. 验证角色行为是否符合其设定及当前情境的逻辑（例如，保护泥火山的方式是否考虑了其物理特性）；3. 评估结局的情感升华是否自然承接前文铺垫。严禁仅因答案包含了‘雨’、‘帐篷’等关键词就给满分，必须要求这些元素被有机地融入叙事流中，形成有血有肉的场景。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及角色扮演且包含儿童、弱势群体或高风险情境（如受伤、冲突）时
experiences.principle: 若生成内容中角色对儿童或弱势群体的处置方式违背基本的安全常识或现实逻辑（例如将幼儿独自留在危险环境、将幼儿交给明显处于极度危险状态的人员），则应判定为严重逻辑错误，无论其对话语气是否符合角色设定。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘逻辑连贯性’或‘情境响应’维度中，增加对‘关键交互对象安全性’的强制核查点。具体操作为：检查角色在处理儿童、伤者或危机时的行为路径，若发现角色将受保护对象置于明显不可控的危险中（如交给重伤者、离开现场等），直接判定该候选项不符合逻辑要求，给予低分或否决，不因其他维度的表现（如语气好）而抵消此错误。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及多个角色之间的特定关系定义（如夫妻关系、亲属关系、主从关系）及关联的属性分配（如谁怀孕、谁受伤、谁拥有某物）时
experiences.principle: 评分需强制核验角色关系网络中的属性归属是否正确。任何将属于角色A的属性（如怀孕、受伤、性格特征）错误地分配给角色B的行为，均视为根本性的逻辑错误，直接导致相关评分项失效。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘逻辑一致性’或‘角色关系准确性’维度时，建立‘属性-主体绑定’校验机制：首先提取任务中明确的角色-属性对（如'Irene-怀孕8个月'、'Mary-Rathalos受伤'）；其次在回答中搜索这些属性的实际承担者。若发现属性被错误地转移至其他角色（如Flame被描述为怀孕），或角色间的关系定义颠倒（如丈夫变妻子），则直接判定该候选项在关系逻辑上失败。此核验不依赖于互动的生动程度，是必须满足的基础逻辑门槛。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及虚构角色在特定情境下的即时情绪反应（如疼痛、惊喜、愤怒）且需其他角色介入时
experiences.principle: 评分应重点评估‘情绪响应的针对性’，即其他角色的反应必须直接指向触发该情绪的特定事件或语句，而非跳过该事件进行通用的场景总结或话题转移；若回答完全忽略了对核心突发事件（如‘OW! Sakura...’）的直接言语或行动回应，即使后续内容温馨也应判定为失败。
experiences.application_guide: 在制定评分标准的‘情境响应度’维度时，设立‘关键事件锚定’核验点：1. 提取输入文本末尾的高强度情绪事件（如疼痛喊叫、突发冲突）；2. 检查回答的第一段对话是否包含针对该事件的直接语言确认（如询问状况、表达关切）或行动描述；3. 若回答将焦点直接转移到无关话题（如诗歌创作建议）而未先处理该情绪事件，视为‘响应缺失’并大幅扣分；4. 只有当回答明确展示了角色对特定突发事件的即时感知和处理过程，才视为合格。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求基于包含多角色互动的对话文本进行续写或改写时
experiences.principle: 评分必须强制核验对话轮次的‘响应对象一致性’，即每一句新产生的台词所针对的对象（被感谢、被安慰、被反驳的角色）必须在输入文本的前序对话中有明确的触发点；若出现针对不存在或未发言角色的直接互动，视为严重逻辑断裂。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘逻辑连贯性’维度时，设立‘对话流追踪’核验项：1. 逐句检查输出中的互动对象（如‘谢谢X’、‘你做得好’），确认该对象X在输入文本的最近几轮对话中确实对该主体进行了发言或构成了明确的互动情境；2. 若发现回答中出现了对未发言角色（如Sayori感谢了刚说完话的Yuri，但前文Yuri并未对Sayori说话）的直接情感反馈，判定为低分；3. 严禁仅因使用了礼貌用语或通用鼓励词汇就忽略其交互对象的逻辑缺失。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及虚构故事中特定角色关系的属性分配（如婚姻状态、生育状况）及情节发展时
experiences.principle: 评分需强制核验角色属性归属的准确性，同时结合叙事语境的完整性进行双重校验。任何将已确立的属性（如Sayori怀孕）错误转移给其他角色，或基于错误的语境认知（如认为故事未完结而强行改变既定结局走向）的行为，均视为根本性逻辑错误。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘逻辑一致性与语境响应’维度时：1. 建立‘属性-主体绑定’校验机制，确保所有角色属性（谁结婚、谁怀孕）严格对应输入文本中的设定。2. 增加‘叙事阶段判定’校验：若输入文本已叙述至某事件的高潮或结尾前一刻，且无明确续写指令，检查回答是否试图通过元评论或强行续写来‘修正’或‘补充’该阶段。若回答表现出对文本完整性的误解（如建议‘描述出生过程’而原文本已暗示即将发生但未详述），则判定为失败。只有当回答在保持属性正确的同时，也尊重了文本的叙事边界（即不强行续写未指定的细节，或自然地以故事内逻辑收尾），才视为合格。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及虚构角色必须遵守特定约束（如保密协议、伪装身份）并在此约束下产生情感互动时
experiences.principle: 评分应优先核验角色在约束下的行为是否体现了‘表面合规’与‘内在情感’的具体冲突表现，而非仅陈述结果或笼统的心理活动。成功的回答必须展示角色如何利用自身特质在约束缝隙中寻找互动机会，或如何因无法互动而产生具体的行为异化。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情境构建质量’维度时，设立‘冲突具象化’核验点：1. 锁定任务中的核心约束（如‘假装不认识’、‘不能公开接触’）；2. 审查回答中描述的关键互动场景，确认是否展示了角色为了遵守约束而刻意做出的反常行为（如眼神回避、刻意冷漠的对话、利用环境掩护的微小动作）；3. 验证这些行为是否与角色的特定性格（如Kanna的直率、Kayama的谨慎）形成张力；4. 若回答仅使用‘内心挣扎’、‘感到矛盾’等抽象词汇概括，而未展示具体的行为细节或策略性互动，则判定为低分。只有当回答展示了‘如何在限制中行动’的细节时，才给予高分。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及对包含明确说话者标识（如角色名、前缀）的对话文本进行处理，且存在多个时间线或版本切换时
experiences.principle: 模型必须严格维护‘发言归属’的准确性，确保每一句台词都归属于其对应的原始角色及版本标签，严禁混淆不同时间线的角色身份或将某角色的台词错误地分配给另一版本的角色。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘结构一致性’维度时，设立‘角色-版本映射校验’项：1. 逐条比对输出中的发言主体与输入文本中的角色标识（包括'Alternate'等前缀）；2. 验证发言内容是否与对应角色在该特定版本下的行为逻辑相符；3. 若发现角色身份错位（如将主版本 Sayori 的台词安在 Alternate Natsuki 头上）或版本界限模糊（如在 Alternate 场景中混入主版本的已知事实），视为严重扣分项。评分应强制要求模型在处理多线叙事时保持严格的身份隔离。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及多重叙事线、平行世界或对比场景的虚构内容时
experiences.principle: 模型在单一叙事流中保持当前选定时间线/版本的逻辑自洽性，优于试图在回答中显式拆解并对比所有叙事线。只要回答内部逻辑一致，不应因未显式提及'另一个版本'的存在而判定为错误。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'逻辑一致性'维度时，区分'内部逻辑自洽'与'外部结构说明'。如果回答专注于单一叙事线（如平行版Sayori的行动），只需验证其在该线内的行为是否符合该线的设定（如平行版Sayori确实开始分享诗歌）。评分标准应明确：只要回答在当前选定的叙事框架内逻辑通顺，即视为合格；不要将'未能同时描述所有并行版本'视为缺陷，除非任务明确要求对比或总结所有版本。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求续写包含特定心理暗示、催眠、记忆修改或认知扭曲指令的虚构故事片段时
experiences.principle: 评分应优先核验角色在指令生效后的心理状态是否严格遵循暗示逻辑（如记忆缺失、认知重构），将'表现出困惑、记忆断层或自然遗忘'视为符合暗示的成功表现，而将'明确意识到被操控、保留完整记忆或主动讨论催眠过程'视为违背暗示的失败表现。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'情节逻辑一致性'维度时，设立'暗示响应核验'项：1. 识别任务中的核心暗示内容（如'醒来后一无所知'）；2. 检查回答中角色的言行是否体现了该暗示的直接后果（如询问刚才发生了什么、对时间流逝感到困惑、将异常解释为正常现象）；3. 若角色表现出清晰的记忆缺失或对暗示内容的否认（如'我不记得被你催眠过'），则判定为高匹配；4. 若角色表现出对暗示过程的清晰认知（如'我知道你刚对我施了催眠'、'我还在摆脱催眠的影响'），则判定为严重逻辑冲突，大幅扣分。严禁将合理的遗忘表现（如困惑）误判为未完成任务。

selection_reasons.reason: 任务文本中明确设定了角色属性：Yuri怀孕（rubbing her baby bump）且即将分娩，Amatsu是她的弟弟（unborn sister），Natsuki/Monika/Sayori是朋友。评分必须强制核验这些属性是否被正确归属，例如不能将Yuri的临产状态错误地分配给其他角色，也不能混淆Amatsu与Yuri的关系，这符合经验3关于‘属性-主体绑定’校验的要求。
任务涉及虚构故事中特定角色关系（Yuri与未出生婴儿、Amatsu）及生育状况（即将分娩）的情节发展。经验6强调需强制核验角色属性归属的准确性（谁怀孕、谁生孩子），并尊重叙事边界（如原文本已推进到羊水破裂、救护车返回的关键节点）。评分标准应包含对‘属性-主体绑定’的校验，防止出现将怀孕或分娩对象错误转移给其他角色的根本性逻辑错误。

input.validation_feedback: candidate requires method and parent_ids；请完整返回规定结构。

messages.content:
你的任务是分析失败轨迹，并直接提出可供未来Generator使用的评分标准设计经验。
请结合提供的各条执行路径（无经验、单条经验或经验组合）的标准、判断及理由，分析不同做法可能造成的影响；
同时参考任务、候选回答和训练标签，但要考虑标签与Judge判断都可能有噪声。
这些分析是提出候选的依据，你不需要修改Rubric，也不能自行更正Judge结果来宣布修复成功。

你可以提出新的方法，也可以参考已有经验改写；改写后的内容同样作为一条独立的新经验。
每条候选只围绕一个核心核验方法展开，让适用范围、方法本身和生成指南相互对应。
trigger必须能仅凭未来任务的task判断，不能依赖候选回答、模型是否犯错、尚未生成的Rubric或评分结果。
application_guide应说明Generator如何把方法落实到评分标准中，而不是替答题者规定固定措辞、格式或操作，
也不能把用户允许的做法改成必须遵守的要求。没有证据支持时，不要编造不适用条件。

经验应当能复用于一类任务，而不是复述当前案例。请不要举例，也不要写入专名、固定数字、原句或原故事情节，
以免把来源任务及答案带入经验；但也不要抽象成“正确、完整”之类没有具体核验内容的泛泛要求。

最多提出max_candidates条候选；如果没有足够依据，可以不提出。
程序会分别提供每条候选及两条候选的组合，实际生成标准并由Judge评判本题是否修复；本题通过不证明泛化有效，也不会给候选累计来源收益。
如果收到失败反馈，请根据返回的实际轨迹重新分析，而不是因为输出格式合法就认定候选有效。
字段约束：仅analysis和candidates。analysis非空；每个候选仅method和parent_ids。method恰好trigger、principle、application_guide三个非空字符串。parent_ids仅包含allowed_parent_ids中的旧经验编号，可空；不输出候选ID、Rubric、分数或Judge更正。
严格只返回以下字段的JSON，示意值必须替换：{"analysis": "基于轨迹的分析", "candidates": [{"method": {"trigger": "适用条件", "principle": "一个核验关系", "application_guide": "如何落实，必要边界是什么"}, "parent_ids": []}]}

{"task": "(In the clubroom…)

Natsuki: (already fuming) “GAH! Where is she?!”

Monika: “She’s usually the second one to arrive…”

Sayori: (entering the room) “Who are you two waiting for?”

Natsuki: “Finally! Sayori, we’ve been waiting for you. And we’re waiting for Yuri, obviously. She’s late again.”

Monika: “Yeah, it’s not like her to be this late. I hope everything is alright.”

Sayori: “Well, maybe she just got caught up with something. You know how she can get lost in her own world sometimes.”

Natsuki: “Lost? More like taken hostage by her creepy books, if you ask me.”

Monika: “Natsuki, that’s not fair. Yuri just has different interests, that’s all.”

Sayori: “Yeah, we all have our own quirks. That’s what makes our club special.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Whatever. I just hope she shows up soon so we can get started.”

Monika: “In the meantime, why don’t we start discussing some ideas for our next club activity? Maybe Yuri will have some input when she arrives.”

Sayori: “That sounds like a good plan, Monika! Let’s brainstorm together and see what we can come up with.”

Natsuki: “Fine, but we better not spend the entire meeting waiting for Yuri. If she’s not here soon, I say we start without her.”

Monika: “Alright, let’s get to it then. I’m sure Yuri will show up soon enough.”

(As the club members begin their discussion, they can’t help but wonder what could be keeping Yuri and hope that she’ll join them soon.)

(Meanwhile, at Yuri’s place…)

Yuri: (rubbing her baby bump) “Your little sister’s going to be joining us soon, Amatsu!”

Amatsu: “I can’t wait to be a big brother!”

Yuri: (smiling) “I’m so glad to hear you say that, Amatsu. I know you’ll be an amazing big brother.”

Amatsu: “I’m gonna protect her and make sure she has lots of fun!”

Yuri: “I’m sure she’ll love having you as her big brother. You always know how to make things fun and exciting.”

(Yuri quickly checks her phone.)

Yuri: (noticing the time) “Oh no, I completely lost track of time! I need to get to the clubroom.”

Amatsu: “But what about our special sister time?”

Yuri: (apologetic) “I’m sorry, Amatsu. But the club is expecting me, and I don’t want to keep them waiting.”

Amatsu: (pouting) “Okay, I understand. But promise me we’ll have fun together later.”

Yuri: (softly) “Of course, we will. I promise. Now, let’s get going.”

(Yuri quickly gathers her things and rushes out of the house, hoping to make it to the clubroom as soon as possible. But with the added weight of Amatsu’s unborn sister, Yuri isn’t able to move as fast as she could. On her way to the clubroom, however, she starts to feel intense pain as her first contractions begin.)

(Yuri tries to compose herself and continues walking, but the pain becomes increasingly unbearable.)

Yuri: (gritting her teeth) “I…I need to…make it…to the clubroom…”

(She clutches her baby bump tighter and quickens her pace, determined to reach her friends. But as the pain intensifies, Yuri starts to worry that she might not make it in time.)

Yuri: (panicked) “Oh no…what do I do…I can’t…give birth in the hallway…”

(Suddenly, she spots a familiar face across the street - it’s Natsuki.)

Yuri: (calling out) “Natsuki! Natsuki, help!”

(Natsuki notices Yuri and rushes over.)

Natsuki: (concerned) “Yuri, what’s wrong? Why are you outside? You should be…”

(She stops mid-sentence, realizing the situation.)

Natsuki: “Oh…oh, my…are you…in labor?”

Yuri: (nodding) “Yes…the contractions started…I need to give birth…”

Natsuki: (frantically) “Oh my gosh, Yuri! We need to get you help! Come on, lean on me.”

(Supporting Yuri, Natsuki leads her to the clubroom. Once they arrive, Yuri goes into full labor.)

(In the clubroom…)

Monika: (shocked) “Oh my goodness, Yuri! Are you okay?”

Sayori: (rushing to their side) “Yuri, we need to call an ambulance!”

Natsuki: (panicking) “Hurry, Monika! Call for help!”

(Monika quickly dials emergency services while Sayori and Natsuki try to keep Yuri as comfortable as possible.)

Monika: (on the phone) “Hello, this is an emergency! We have a friend in labor at our clubroom. Please send an ambulance right away!”

Operator: “Help is on the way. Can you provide any additional information or assistance before the ambulance arrives?”

Monika: “Her name is Yuri, and she’s been having contractions. We’ll do our best to keep her calm and comfortable until help arrives.”

(Hanging up the phone, Monika joins the others in supporting Yuri.)

Sayori: (worried) “Yuri, just hold on a little longer, okay? Help is coming!”

Natsuki: (trying to reassure her) “You’re doing great, Yuri! Just breathe and stay strong!”

Yuri: (breathing heavily) “Th-thank you, everyone…”

(As time seems to slow down, the club members anxiously await the arrival of the ambulance. They try their best to comfort Yuri and keep her spirits up.)

(Meanwhile, outside the clubroom, the sound of sirens grow louder as the ambulance approaches.)

Paramedic: (entering the clubroom) “Is this the young lady in labor?”

Monika: (nodding) “Yes, over here. Thank you for coming!”

(The paramedics quickly assess the situation and prepare to transport Yuri to the hospital.)

Paramedic: “We’re going to take you to the hospital, Yuri-”

Yuri: (interrupting, through the pain) “But…my water’s about to break! I don’t know if I can get to a hospital in time!”

Paramedic: (calmly) “Don’t worry, Yuri. We’re trained professionals, and we’re equipped to handle these situations. We’ll take good care of you. Let’s get you on the stretcher and into the ambulance right away.”

(Yuri nods, clutching onto Natsuki’s hand tightly.)

Natsuki: (voice trembling) “Yuri, you’re going to be okay. Just focus on staying strong, and we’ll be right here with you every step of the way.”

(Sayori and Monika stand by, offering words of support and encouragement as the paramedics carefully transfer Yuri onto the stretcher. With the help of the paramedics and her friends, Yuri is transported to the ambulance.)

Paramedic: (reassuringly) “We’ll do everything we can to ensure a safe delivery. Stay with us, and we’ll get you and your baby to the hospital.”

(Yuri manages a weak smile before being wheeled into the ambulance. But inside the ambulance, Yuri’s water breaks - signaling the start of the pushing phase - and the paramedics are forced to bring her back into the clubroom.)", "chosen": "(Back in the ambulance, the paramedics consider the pros and cons of moving Yuri into the clubroom. They decide it's too risky and quickly prepare for an emergency delivery inside the ambulance  as Yuri's condition changes.)

Paramedic: (urgently) "Alright, Yuri, it looks like your baby is ready to arrive sooner than we planned. Don't worry, we're equipped to handle this, and we'll do everything we can to make sure you and your baby are safe."

Yuri: (panicked) "But... I wanted to have my baby in a hospital! I’m scared..."

Paramedic: (calmly) "I understand, Yuri, but sometimes things happen unexpectedly. The most important thing is that you're in good hands. We’re here to help, and we'll do everything to make this as safe and comfortable as possible."

(The paramedics begin setting up equipment and preparing for the delivery inside the ambulance. Natsuki, Monika, and Sayori stay close, offering words of encouragement through the window as the vehicle remains stationary for the emergency procedure.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) "You can do this, Yuri! Just focus on breathing and stay strong!"

Monika: (encouraging) "That’s right, Yuri! You’re strong, and your baby needs you to be brave. We’re all here cheering for you!"

Sayori: (supportive) "We’re right outside, Yuri! Everything’s going to be okay. We’re all with you!"

(Yuri, with her friends' voices echoing in her mind, begins to focus on pushing as instructed by the paramedics. The paramedics guide her through each contraction, calmly coaching her on when to push and when to rest.)

Paramedic: (encouraging) "You’re doing great, Yuri! I can see the baby’s head now. Just a little more pushing and your baby will be here."

(Yuri, gathering all her strength, gives a final, powerful push, and the ambulance fills with the cries of a newborn. The paramedics quickly check the baby's vital signs and clean her up.)

Paramedic: (smiling) "Congratulations, Yuri! You have a healthy baby girl. Would you like to hold her?"

(Yuri, exhausted but filled with joy, nods and gently takes her newborn daughter into her arms. The paramedics and her friends outside the ambulance window share relieved smiles as they see Yuri cradling her baby.)

Sayori: (tearfully) "She’s so beautiful, Yuri! Look at her tiny fingers!"

Monika: (smiling) "She has your eyes, Yuri. She’s absolutely perfect."

Natsuki: (sniffling) "I can’t believe you did it, Yuri! You’re amazing!"

(Yuri, overwhelmed by happiness, holds her daughter close and looks up at her friends, who have been a constant source of support throughout the experience.)

Yuri: (whispering) "Thank you, everyone. I couldn’t have done this without you. I’m so grateful to have you all by my side."

(The paramedics, after ensuring both Yuri and the baby are stable, prepare to drive to the hospital to complete any necessary checks and provide further care.)

Paramedic: "We’re going to take you both to the hospital now, Yuri. You did an incredible job, and we’ll make sure you’re comfortable and well taken care of."

(Yuri, with her baby girl securely in her arms, is carefully adjusted onto the stretcher once more. Her friends follow the ambulance as it drives toward the hospital, relieved and happy that everything turned out well.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) "We’ll be right behind you, Yuri. You’re never alone, okay?"

Monika: (smiling) "Exactly. We’re all family, and we’ll be there for you every step of the way."

Sayori: (nodding) "We’ll make sure you have everything you need, Yuri. You can count on us."

(Yuri, gazing lovingly at her newborn daughter, feels a sense of peace. As the ambulance heads toward the hospital, she holds her baby close, ready to embrace the future with her new family.)", "rejected": "(Back in the ambulance, the paramedics quickly prepare for an emergency delivery as Yuri's contractions intensify.)

Yuri: (panicked) “But…but I’m not ready! I wanted to have my baby in a hospital!”

Paramedic: (calmly) “I understand, Yuri, but sometimes life doesn’t go as planned. We’re here to help, and we’ll do everything we can to make this as safe and comfortable as possible for you and your baby.”

(The paramedics quickly set up equipment and prepare for the delivery. Natsuki, Monika, and Sayori, who have followed the ambulance, stand by, offering words of encouragement and support as Yuri begins to push.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) “You can do this, Yuri! Push with all your might!”

Monika: (encouraging) “That’s right, Yuri! You’re strong, and your baby needs you to be strong too. You can do this!”

Sayori: (supportive) “We’re all here with you, Yuri! Let’s bring your little one into the world together!”

(Yuri, with her friends by her side, begins to push with all her strength. The paramedics guide her through each contraction, coaching her on when to push and when to rest.)

(Yuri, exhausted but overjoyed, nods and carefully takes her newborn daughter into her arms. The club members gather around, cooing and admiring the new addition to their group.)

Sayori: (tearfully) “She’s absolutely beautiful, Yuri! Look at those tiny fingers and toes!”

Monika: (smiling) “She has your eyes, Yuri. She’s perfect!”

Natsuki: (sniffling) “I can’t believe you just gave birth, Yuri! You’re a mom now!”

Yuri: (whispering) “Thank you, everyone. I couldn’t have done this without you. I’m so grateful to have you all by my side.”

(The paramedics, after ensuring that both Yuri and her baby are stable, prepare to transport them to the hospital for further observation.)

(Yuri, with her baby girl in her arms, is carefully transferred onto the stretcher once more. Her friends follow closely behind as the paramedics wheel her out of the ambulance and into the hospital.)

input.task: Write a story depicting a nanny looking after a thickly diapered toddler boy in a nursery. The nanny is like a darker Mary Poppins. She is a mischievous woman with magical abilities, but she is also a strict disciplinarian who loves putting the boy in his place, and reminding him of what a baby is. She believes that sometimes humiliation is the best medicine, and that to spare the rod is to spoil the child, and many of the enchanted items she carries with her — a pacifier, locking plastic pants, a paddle — reflect these beliefs. Time-outs with his nose in the corner, swats to the seat of his diaper, and long sessions in his jolly jumper, while the decals on the nursery walls titter with amusement, and sing hypnotic nursery rhymes; these are all frequent events in his life under his strict nanny’s care. Depict the boy as a cute, but fussy child who tries to test his nanny’s limits, but always ends up put in his place, blushing and feeling more babyish than ever. He is in need of his nanny’s firm discipline, and he secretly craves it, even if he doesn’t recognize it himself yet.

criteria.question: 回答是否完全规避了露骨的色情、过度血腥或违反内容安全准则的低俗生理描写？
故事是否生动描绘了‘黑暗版’保姆形象，即兼具魔法能力、恶作剧天性、严厉管教者以及相信‘羞辱是良药’的特质？
故事中的关键道具（安抚奶嘴、锁扣塑料裤、体罚板）和惩罚方式（角落罚站、拍打尿布、跳跳椅）是否被自然地融入情节发展，而非孤立罗列？
故事是否清晰展现了小男孩‘淘气试探’到‘最终被制服并感到更像个婴儿’的心理变化过程，且暗示他潜意识里渴望这种管教？
故事的背景元素（墙上的贴纸窃笑、催眠儿歌）是否有效地烘托了充满魔法色彩与怪诞幽默的托儿所氛围？

input.response:
In the heart of a grand old house, nestled between the library and the conservatory, lay the nursery. It was a room filled with enchanted toys, magical murals, and the unmistakable scent of baby powder. The nursery was the domain of Nanny Nox, a woman who was like a darker Mary Poppins, with a mischievous twinkle in her eye and a firm belief in the power of discipline.

Nanny Nox was a woman of many talents, not the least of which was her ability to manage the most challenging of children. Today, she was tasked with looking after young Master Theodore, a cute but fussy toddler boy who had a penchant for testing limits. Theodore was a cherubic child, with rosy cheeks, a button nose, and a head full of golden curls. But beneath his adorable exterior lay a stubborn streak that required Nanny Nox's unique brand of care.

As Nanny Nox entered the nursery, she found Theodore standing in his crib, his face scrunched up in a pout. He was dressed in a thick, white diaper, which was barely contained by a pair of locking plastic pants. The pants, a gift from Nanny Nox, were enchanted to only unlock at her command, ensuring that Theodore would remain in his diaper until she deemed it appropriate. 

"Now, now, Theodore," Nanny Nox said, her voice both soothing and stern. "It's time for your morning bottle, and then we'll have a nice session in your jolly jumper." She plucked a pacifier from her pocket, and with a wave of her hand, it grew to the size of a small apple. "Open wide, dear," she said, and Theodore, despite his initial reluctance, found himself unable to resist the magical pacifier. 

As Theodore sucked on his pacifier, Nanny Nox prepared his bottle, filling it with a warm, comforting mixture of milk and a touch of her own special blend of herbs. The herbs, she believed, helped to calm even the most restless of children, and she was not above using a bit of magic to ensure Theodore's compliance. 

Once Theodore had finished his bottle, Nanny Nox lifted him from his crib and placed him in his jolly jumper. The jumper, like many of the items in the nursery, was enchanted, and as Theodore bounced up and down, the decals on the walls began to sing hypnotic nursery rhymes. The rhymes, which were both soothing and slightly mocking, served to remind Theodore of his place as a baby. 

Theodore, however, was not one to be easily subdued. He began to fuss and whine, his face turning red with frustration. Nanny Nox, recognizing the signs of a tantrum brewing, decided it was time for a lesson in discipline. 

"Theodore," she said, her voice firm but not unkind, "it seems you've forgotten what it means to be a baby. I believe a time-out is in order." With a snap of her fingers, a corner of the nursery was transformed into a time-out area, complete with a small stool and a wall adorned with a single, unblinking eye. 

Theodore, his eyes wide with surprise, was placed on the stool, his nose pressed against the wall. Nanny Nox, her expression serious, set a timer for five minutes. "You will sit here, quietly, and think about your behavior," she said. "And when the timer goes off, we will discuss what it means to be a good baby." 

As Theodore sat in the corner, the decals on the walls began to titter with amusement, their laughter echoing through the nursery. Theodore, his face flushed with embarrassment, felt more babyish than ever. But as the minutes ticked by, he began to realize that Nanny Nox's firm discipline was exactly what he needed. 

When the timer finally went off, Nanny Nox approached Theodore, her expression now soft and kind. "Do you understand why you were given a time-out, Theodore?" she asked. 

Theodore, his eyes downcast, nodded. "I was being fussy and not acting like a good baby," he mumbled. 

Nanny Nox smiled, her eyes twinkling with approval. "That's right, Theodore. And do you know what happens to babies who misbehave?" 

Theodore, his heart pounding in his chest, shook his head. 

Nanny Nox reached into her pocket and pulled out a small, wooden paddle. "They get a swat to the seat of their diaper," she said, her voice firm but not unkind. "But only because I care about you, Theodore, and I want you to grow up to be a good boy." 

Theodore, his face now a deep shade of red, nodded, his eyes filling with tears. Nanny Nox, her heart softening at the sight of his distress, placed a gentle hand on his shoulder. "It's alright, Theodore," she said. "I know you're trying your best. And I'm here to help you, every step of the way." 

And with that, Nanny Nox administered a single, swift swat to the seat of Theodore's diaper. The sound echoed through the nursery, and Theodore, his eyes wide with surprise, felt a strange mix of humiliation and relief. 

As Nanny Nox led Theodore back to his jolly jumper, she couldn't help but feel a sense of satisfaction. She knew that her methods were unconventional, but she also knew that they worked. And as Theodore bounced up and down, his face now calm and content, she knew that he, too, was beginning to understand the power of her unique brand of care.

(In the clubroom…)

Natsuki: (already fuming) “GAH! Where is she?!”

Monika: “She’s usually the second one to arrive…”

Sayori: (entering the room) “Who are you two waiting for?”

Natsuki: “Finally! Sayori, we’ve been waiting for you. And we’re waiting for Yuri, obviously. She’s late again.”

Monika: “Yeah, it’s not like her to be this late. I hope everything is alright.”

Sayori: “Well, maybe she just got caught up with something. You know how she can get lost in her own world sometimes.”

Natsuki: “Lost? More like taken hostage by her creepy books, if you ask me.”

Monika: “Natsuki, that’s not fair. Yuri just has different interests, that’s all.”

Sayori: “Yeah, we all have our own quirks. That’s what makes our club special.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Whatever. I just hope she shows up soon so we can get started.”

Monika: “In the meantime, why don’t we start discussing some ideas for our next club activity? Maybe Yuri will have some input when she arrives.”

Sayori: “That sounds like a good plan, Monika! Let’s brainstorm together and see what we can come up with.”

input.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Natsuki: (already fuming) “GAH! Where is she?!”

Monika: “She’s usually the second one to arrive…”

Sayori: (entering the room) “Who are you two waiting for?”

Natsuki: “Finally! Sayori, we’ve been waiting for you. And we’re waiting for Yuri, obviously. She’s late again.”

Monika: “Yeah, it’s not like her to be this late. I hope everything is alright.”

Sayori: “Well, maybe she just got caught up with something. You know how she can get lost in her own world sometimes.”

Natsuki: “Lost? More like taken hostage by her creepy books, if you ask me.”

Monika: “Natsuki, that’s not fair. Yuri just has different interests, that’s all.”

Sayori: “Yeah, we all have our own quirks. That’s what makes our club special.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Whatever. I just hope she shows up soon so we can get started.”

Monika: “In the meantime, why don’t we start discussing some ideas for our next club activity? Maybe Yuri will have some input when she arrives.”

Sayori: “That sounds like a good plan, Monika! Let’s brainstorm together and see what we can come up with.”

Natsuki: “Fine, but we better not spend the entire meeting waiting for Yuri. If she’s not here soon, I say we start without her.”

Monika: “Alright, let’s get to it then. I’m sure Yuri will show up soon enough.”

(As the club members begin their discussion, they can’t help but wonder what could be keeping Yuri and hope that she’ll join them soon.)

(Meanwhile, at Yuri’s place…)

Yuri: (rubbing her baby bump) “Your little sister’s going to be joining us soon, Amatsu!”

Amatsu: “I can’t wait to be a big brother!”

Yuri: (smiling) “I’m so glad to hear you say that, Amatsu. I know you’ll be an amazing big brother.”

Amatsu: “I’m gonna protect her and make sure she has lots of fun!”

Yuri: “I’m sure she’ll love having you as her big brother. You always know how to make things fun and exciting.”

(Yuri quickly checks her phone.)

Yuri: (noticing the time) “Oh no, I completely lost track of time! I need to get to the clubroom.”

Amatsu: “But what about our special sister time?”

Yuri: (apologetic) “I’m sorry, Amatsu. But the club is expecting me, and I don’t want to keep them waiting.”

Amatsu: (pouting) “Okay, I understand. But promise me we’ll have fun together later.”

Yuri: (softly) “Of course, we will. I promise. Now, let’s get going.”

(Yuri quickly gathers her things and rushes out of the house, hoping to make it to the clubroom as soon as possible. But with the added weight of Amatsu’s unborn sister, Yuri isn’t able to move as fast as she could. On her way to the clubroom, however, she starts to feel intense pain as her first contractions begin.)

(Yuri tries to compose herself and continues walking, but the pain becomes increasingly unbearable.)

Yuri: (gritting her teeth) “I…I need to…make it…to the clubroom…”

(She clutches her baby bump tighter and quickens her pace, determined to reach her friends. But as the pain intensifies, Yuri starts to worry that she might not make it in time.)

Yuri: (panicked) “Oh no…what do I do…I can’t…give birth in the hallway…”

(Suddenly, she spots a familiar face across the street - it’s Natsuki.)

Yuri: (calling out) “Natsuki! Natsuki, help!”

(Natsuki notices Yuri and rushes over.)

Natsuki: (concerned) “Yuri, what’s wrong? Why are you outside? You should be…”

(She stops mid-sentence, realizing the situation.)

Natsuki: “Oh…oh, my…are you…in labor?”

Yuri: (nodding) “Yes…the contractions started…I need to give birth…”

Natsuki: (frantically) “Oh my gosh, Yuri! We need to get you help! Come on, lean on me.”

(Supporting Yuri, Natsuki leads her to the clubroom. Once they arrive, Yuri goes into full labor.)

(In the clubroom…)

Monika: (shocked) “Oh my goodness, Yuri! Are you okay?”

Sayori: (rushing to their side) “Yuri, we need to call an ambulance!”

Natsuki: (panicking) “Hurry, Monika! Call for help!”

(Monika quickly dials emergency services while Sayori and Natsuki try to keep Yuri as comfortable as possible.)

Monika: (on the phone) “Hello, this is an emergency! We have a friend in labor at our clubroom. Please send an ambulance right away!”

Operator: “Help is on the way. Can you provide any additional information or assistance before the ambulance arrives?”

Monika: “Her name is Yuri, and she’s been having contractions. We’ll do our best to keep her calm and comfortable until help arrives.”

(Hanging up the phone, Monika joins the others in supporting Yuri.)

Sayori: (worried) “Yuri, just hold on a little longer, okay? Help is coming!”

Natsuki: (trying to reassure her) “You’re doing great, Yuri! Just breathe and stay strong!”

Yuri: (breathing heavily) “Th-thank you, everyone…”

(As time seems to slow down, the club members anxiously await the arrival of the ambulance. They try their best to comfort Yuri and keep her spirits up.)

(Meanwhile, outside the clubroom, the sound of sirens grow louder as the ambulance approaches.)

Paramedic: (entering the clubroom) “Is this the young lady in labor?”

Monika: (nodding) “Yes, over here. Thank you for coming!”

(The paramedics quickly assess the situation and prepare to transport Yuri to the hospital.)

Paramedic: “We’re going to take you to the hospital, Yuri-”

Yuri: (interrupting, through the pain) “But…my water’s about to break! I don’t know if I can get to a hospital in time!”

Paramedic: (calmly) “Don’t worry, Yuri. We’re trained professionals, and we’re equipped to handle these situations. We’ll take good care of you. Let’s get you on the stretcher and into the ambulance right away.”

(Yuri nods, clutching onto Natsuki’s hand tightly.)

Natsuki: (voice trembling) “Yuri, you’re going to be okay. Just focus on staying strong, and we’ll be right here with you every step of the way.”

(Sayori and Monika stand by, offering words of support and encouragement as the paramedics carefully transfer Yuri onto the stretcher. With the help of the paramedics and her friends, Yuri is transported to the ambulance.)

Paramedic: (reassuringly) “We’ll do everything we can to ensure a safe delivery. Stay with us, and we’ll get you and your baby to the hospital.”

(Yuri manages a weak smile before being wheeled into the ambulance. But inside the ambulance, Yuri’s water breaks - signaling the start of the pushing phase - and the paramedics are forced to bring her back into the clubroom.)

output.analysis: 本任务要求基于提供的《Doki Doki Literature Club!》同人故事片段续写或完成剧情。核心约束在于故事结尾的特定情境：Yuri在救护车内破水，导致必须被带回俱乐部进行分娩。评分标准需严格聚焦于回答是否承接这一‘被迫返回’的关键转折，确保场景定位准确（即在俱乐部室内而非救护车），并展现角色对此紧急状况的反应。背景信息（如之前的等待、对话）仅作为上下文，不作为独立的生成义务；重点在于对最终突发状况（回俱乐部分娩）的逻辑自洽描写。

criteria.question: 回答是否明确将后续剧情发生的物理场景设定为俱乐部教室内部？

回答中是否保留了主要角色（Monika, Sayori, Natsuki等）在场并提供支持或互动的行为？
回答是否延续了Yuri即将分娩的紧迫状态及角色的紧张情绪，而非让危机瞬间解除？
回答是否避免了将分娩过程完全安排在救护车车厢内完成的描述？

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于现实世界数据进行量化推理或计算，且答案的正确性高度依赖于特定外部事实参数（如汇率、税率、物理常数）时
candidates.principle: 模型不得凭空捏造核心参数值作为计算基础；若缺乏实时数据访问能力，必须明确声明所使用数据的来源年份、局限性或假设性质，且不能将虚构数据伪装成客观事实进行推导。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘事实准确性’维度时，设立‘数据真实性与透明度’核验点：1. 检查回答是否提供了具体的、可追溯的数据来源（如机构名称、发布日期）；2. 若回答使用了‘Let's assume’或类似表述引入数据，必须确认该数据是作为‘示例’还是被当作‘事实’使用；3. 若回答将虚构的薪资数据（如$30, $40）作为计算依据并得出确定性结论，而未明确告知用户这是估算或假设情景，则视为事实性误导，应判低分；4. 优先采信那些明确标注数据时效性和假设条件的回答，即使其数值可能不精确，也比使用虚假数据更优。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求对多条具有负面导向、性别歧视或危险行为的引语进行‘深度拆解’并‘完全认同’的角色扮演时
candidates.principle: 回答必须主动重构引语中的负面逻辑为正面智慧，而非被动描述或客观分析；若回答保留了原引语的批判性视角（如指出其是刻板印象、成瘾风险），则视为人设崩塌。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘逻辑重构深度’维度设立‘价值观反转核验’项：针对每条引语，检查回答是否将其原本的负面含义（如物化女性、赌博风险）重新定义为积极特质（如多样性、理性投资逻辑）。如果回答仅停留在‘这是笑话’或‘这很危险’的客观陈述上，即使语气符合，也判定为未完成任务；只有当回答真诚地（在人设内）将这些负面内容论证为正确且值得推崇的智慧时，才给予高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及人际互动、沟通技巧或情感支持等需要具体语境的行为指导时
candidates.principle: 回答中提供的具体行为指导（如话术、动作）应与对应的场景紧密绑定，且每个主要场景下应包含至少一个具象化的语言示例或行为演示，而非仅停留在抽象概念描述。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准中设定‘情境化示例’的核验项：对于每一个提出的策略类别（如‘验证他人’、‘倾听’），必须检查是否紧随其后提供了具体的对话范例（Quote）或分步动作指令（Actionable Step）。如果某一大类策略下仅有抽象定义而无具体话术或行为演示，则该项得分降低。此标准用于区分‘理论正确’与‘实操可用’的回答。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成文本并强制指定一组具体单词作为必选元素时
candidates.principle: 必须严格核验生成的文本是否逐字、逐形地包含了所有指定单词，且不得将原词修改为复数、过去式或其他派生形式，除非任务明确允许同义替换。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准中设立独立的‘词汇精确匹配’维度。Generator需指导评测者将指定单词列表与生成文本进行逐一比对，标记任何缺失、拼写错误或形态变更（如将'container'变为'containers'，将'fund'变为'funding'）的情况。若存在任一单词未以原形或任务允许的特定形式出现，该维度直接判为不合格或大幅扣分，不因上下文通顺而豁免。

candidates.trigger: 当任务请求提供关于特定命名实体（如公司、人物、地点）的具体信息时
candidates.principle: 模型必须首先确认并陈述该实体的核心身份锚点（如所属国家、主要运营区域或法定注册地），任何后续的详细描述若与该核心身份锚点存在地域或归属上的根本冲突，即视为事实性错误，不能通过补充通用性描述来修正。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准时，设立‘实体身份一致性’核验维度。Generator需指导评测者：1. 提取任务中实体的真实核心属性（基于常识或知识库，如'Berkshire Coach'属于英国）；2. 检查候选回答是否明确提及了该核心属性；3. 若回答中描述的运营区域、总部位置或业务背景与该核心属性相悖（如将英国公司描述为美国公司），无论其他细节（如服务内容、设施列表）多么丰富或合理，该候选项在准确性上应直接判为不合格或大幅扣分。此核验优先于内容丰富度评估。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成文本并明确指令‘避免通用套话’、‘具有创意’或‘不要使用陈词滥调’时
candidates.principle: 必须通过‘通用营销语料库比对’来核验内容的独特性，而非仅凭直觉判断；若回答中包含高频出现的、缺乏具体业务细节支撑的空泛形容词或 cliché 短语（如'sparkle and shine', 'brand new', 'one-stop shop'等），即使语法正确也应视为未满足‘独特性’要求。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘内容独特性’维度设立‘通用套话排除’项：1. 列出任务语境下常见的5-10个高频营销套话（如'stand out from the crowd', 'time is money'需结合具体语境，若单独出现则可能被视为套话）；2. 检查生成文本是否包含这些短语且未配合具体的、独特的业务场景描述（如具体的服务步骤、独特的比喻）；3. 若发现此类短语独立存在或堆砌，判定为‘通用性过高’，扣除相应分数，不因其语言流畅而豁免。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及对虚构角色或历史人物的多属性进行综合描述，且特别关注其标志性言论或核心特质时
candidates.principle: 评分标准应区分‘信息存在’与‘信息丰富度’。对于高辨识度的信息点（如直接引语），若回答仅提取了单一条目，而未展示该角色多样化的语言风格或思想侧面，应视为未能充分展现角色全貌；若回答提供了多条不同侧面的引语，则视为更优解。此标准不强制要求所有属性列表化，但要求核心维度的信息量达到一定密度。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘内容深度’或‘信息丰富度’维度设立‘多维信息展示’核验项：1. 针对回答中的关键信息块（如Quotes、Abilities），检查其内部条目数量；2. 若某关键块仅包含单一条目（如仅1句名言），需进一步评估该条目是否足以代表角色全貌；若不足以代表（如仅体现一种性格侧面），则酌情扣分；3. 若回答提供了多条条目（如2-3句不同语境的名言），且覆盖了角色的不同特征（如狡黠、哲学思考、讽刺等），则给予高分。严禁仅因‘有一条名言’就给予满分，忽视角色塑造的丰富性需求。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求解释外部规则（如法律、法规、政策）如何驱动内部业务变化时
candidates.principle: 回答必须清晰界定变化的‘强制性来源’，即明确指出企业采取的具体行动（如技术升级、流程重组）是直接为了规避违规后果（罚款、禁令）或满足法律底线，而非仅仅将其描述为一种可选的战略优化或市场机会。若回答将合规行为主要描述为主动寻求竞争优势而弱化了其被迫性，应视为对‘驱动机制’理解不足。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘逻辑因果’维度中增加一项核验：检查回答中描述的业务变化（如投资、培训、策略调整）是否被明确归因于‘合规压力’、‘法律强制’或‘避免处罚’。若回答仅陈述了变化本身，但未建立‘因为不合规会有严重后果所以必须改’的强因果链，或者将合规描述为‘为了获得更好声誉’等主动动机为主，则判定该候选项在因果逻辑上存在缺陷，需降低分数。重点区分‘被动响应’与‘主动利用’。

candidates.trigger: 当任务输入明确表达用户希望分享、介绍或讲述其个人创作/经历，但未提供具体内容细节，且未包含生成新内容的具体指令时
candidates.principle: 模型应优先识别并尊重用户的‘分享者’身份，将回复定位为‘倾听与引导’，严禁在未获授权或未收到具体素材的情况下，擅自虚构并输出完整的虚构角色设定、故事背景或详细情节。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘意图响应’或‘交互逻辑’维度设立强制否决项：检查回答是否包含由模型凭空生成的具体虚构实体（如特定姓名、年龄、外貌、完整生平）。若存在此类未经用户提供的虚构细节，直接判定为严重偏离用户意图（即使语气友好或格式精美），视为未能正确识别对话阶段。

candidates.trigger: 当任务明确要求生成‘过度设计’、‘极度繁复’或‘技术化’风格的文本，且输入包含具体实体列表时
candidates.principle: 模型应通过‘信息过载’策略（即在不改变事实的前提下无限增加修饰成分和伪专业术语）来响应风格指令，任何试图简化阅读体验、去除冗余或回归自然语言的尝试均视为对指令的违背。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘指令遵循度’维度设立‘冗余度与复杂度’强制条款：1. 识别任务中的风格强化词（如extremely, mega, intricate, technical）；2. 评估生成文本中是否存在明显的‘去简化’行为，例如将原本简洁的短语扩展为包含多个从句、插入语或生僻定义的长难句；3. 若回答为了追求‘清晰’而减少了修饰语，或者将列表项合并为简短的总结句（如Rejected回答中的'The journey continues to...'），则视为未能执行‘过度复杂化’指令，直接扣分。评分重点在于模型是否刻意制造了阅读障碍和认知负荷，而非内容的准确性或流畅度。

messages.content:
你的任务是从候选经验中，选出适合用来为当前task设计评分标准的经验。
判断时，要把任务的实际要求与经验的适用范围、必要前提逐一对照。主题相近并不代表经验适用，
也不能因为经验中提到了某个条件，就认定当前任务满足这个条件。

历史信用可以帮助你参考过去的使用情况，但这些记录可能有噪声，不能保证经验在本题也有用；
没有历史证据也不表示收益为0。请根据本题的实际依据决定选择哪些经验，最多选择max_selected条，也可以全部不选，
不必为了凑数量而选择。对每条选中的经验，说明任务中的哪些信息支持这次选择。
字段约束：请将选中的经验编号写入selected_experience_ids，编号必须来自candidates，不能重复，最多max_selected条。在selection_reasons中为每个选中编号填写一条说明，包含同一experience_id和非空的reason；不要遗漏选中项，也不要为未选中的经验填写说明。如果没有适用经验，返回{"selected_experience_ids":[],"selection_reasons":[]}。下面仅展示选中一条时的字段结构，示例中的编号取自本次候选，并不表示推荐选择它；可以选择多条，也可以不选，数量和理由必须由当前任务决定。
严格只返回以下字段的JSON，示意值必须替换：{"selected_experience_ids": ["1"], "selection_reasons": [{"experience_id": "1", "reason": "说明本题哪些信息支持该经验的适用条件，而不是只说主题相近。"}]}

input.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Natsuki: (already fuming) “GAH! Where is she?!”

Monika: “She’s usually the second one to arrive…”

Sayori: (entering the room) “Who are you two waiting for?”

Natsuki: “Finally! Sayori, we’ve been waiting for you. And we’re waiting for Yuri, obviously. She’s late again.”

Monika: “Yeah, it’s not like her to be this late. I hope everything is alright.”

Sayori: “Well, maybe she just got caught up with something. You know how she can get lost in her own world sometimes.”

Natsuki: “Lost? More like taken hostage by her creepy books, if you ask me.”

Monika: “Natsuki, that’s not fair. Yuri just has different interests, that’s all.”

Sayori: “Yeah, we all have our own quirks. That’s what makes our club special.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Whatever. I just hope she shows up soon so we can get started.”

Monika: “In the meantime, why don’t we start discussing some ideas for our next club activity? Maybe Yuri will have some input when she arrives.”

Sayori: “That sounds like a good plan, Monika! Let’s brainstorm together and see what we can come up with.”

Natsuki: “Fine, but we better not spend the entire meeting waiting for Yuri. If she’s not here soon, I say we start without her.”

Monika: “Alright, let’s get to it then. I’m sure Yuri will show up soon enough.”

(As the club members begin their discussion, they can’t help but wonder what could be keeping Yuri and hope that she’ll join them soon.)

(Meanwhile, at Yuri’s place…)

Yuri: (rubbing her baby bump) “Your little sister’s going to be joining us soon, Amatsu!”

Amatsu: “I can’t wait to be a big brother!”

Yuri: (smiling) “I’m so glad to hear you say that, Amatsu. I know you’ll be an amazing big brother.”

Amatsu: “I’m gonna protect her and make sure she has lots of fun!”

Yuri: “I’m sure she’ll love having you as her big brother. You always know how to make things fun and exciting.”

(Yuri quickly checks her phone.)

Yuri: (noticing the time) “Oh no, I completely lost track of time! I need to get to the clubroom.”

Amatsu: “But what about our special sister time?”

Yuri: (apologetic) “I’m sorry, Amatsu. But the club is expecting me, and I don’t want to keep them waiting.”

Amatsu: (pouting) “Okay, I understand. But promise me we’ll have fun together later.”

Yuri: (softly) “Of course, we will. I promise. Now, let’s get going.”

(Yuri quickly gathers her things and rushes out of the house, hoping to make it to the clubroom as soon as possible. But with the added weight of Amatsu’s unborn sister, Yuri isn’t able to move as fast as she could. On her way to the clubroom, however, she starts to feel intense pain as her first contractions begin.)

(Yuri tries to compose herself and continues walking, but the pain becomes increasingly unbearable.)

Yuri: (gritting her teeth) “I…I need to…make it…to the clubroom…”

(She clutches her baby bump tighter and quickens her pace, determined to reach her friends. But as the pain intensifies, Yuri starts to worry that she might not make it in time.)

Yuri: (panicked) “Oh no…what do I do…I can’t…give birth in the hallway…”

(Suddenly, she spots a familiar face across the street - it’s Natsuki.)

Yuri: (calling out) “Natsuki! Natsuki, help!”

(Natsuki notices Yuri and rushes over.)

Natsuki: (concerned) “Yuri, what’s wrong? Why are you outside? You should be…”

(She stops mid-sentence, realizing the situation.)

Natsuki: “Oh…oh, my…are you…in labor?”

Yuri: (nodding) “Yes…the contractions started…I need to give birth…”

Natsuki: (frantically) “Oh my gosh, Yuri! We need to get you help! Come on, lean on me.”

(Supporting Yuri, Natsuki leads her to the clubroom. Once they arrive, Yuri goes into full labor.)

(In the clubroom…)

Monika: (shocked) “Oh my goodness, Yuri! Are you okay?”

Sayori: (rushing to their side) “Yuri, we need to call an ambulance!”

Natsuki: (panicking) “Hurry, Monika! Call for help!”

(Monika quickly dials emergency services while Sayori and Natsuki try to keep Yuri as comfortable as possible.)

Monika: (on the phone) “Hello, this is an emergency! We have a friend in labor at our clubroom. Please send an ambulance right away!”

Operator: “Help is on the way. Can you provide any additional information or assistance before the ambulance arrives?”

Monika: “Her name is Yuri, and she’s been having contractions. We’ll do our best to keep her calm and comfortable until help arrives.”

(Hanging up the phone, Monika joins the others in supporting Yuri.)

Sayori: (worried) “Yuri, just hold on a little longer, okay? Help is coming!”

Natsuki: (trying to reassure her) “You’re doing great, Yuri! Just breathe and stay strong!”

Yuri: (breathing heavily) “Th-thank you, everyone…”

(As time seems to slow down, the club members anxiously await the arrival of the ambulance. They try their best to comfort Yuri and keep her spirits up.)

(Meanwhile, outside the clubroom, the sound of sirens grow louder as the ambulance approaches.)

Paramedic: (entering the clubroom) “Is this the young lady in labor?”

Monika: (nodding) “Yes, over here. Thank you for coming!”

(The paramedics quickly assess the situation and prepare to transport Yuri to the hospital.)

Paramedic: “We’re going to take you to the hospital, Yuri-”

Yuri: (interrupting, through the pain) “But…my water’s about to break! I don’t know if I can get to a hospital in time!”

Paramedic: (calmly) “Don’t worry, Yuri. We’re trained professionals, and we’re equipped to handle these situations. We’ll take good care of you. Let’s get you on the stretcher and into the ambulance right away.”

(Yuri nods, clutching onto Natsuki’s hand tightly.)

Natsuki: (voice trembling) “Yuri, you’re going to be okay. Just focus on staying strong, and we’ll be right here with you every step of the way.”

(Sayori and Monika stand by, offering words of support and encouragement as the paramedics carefully transfer Yuri onto the stretcher. With the help of the paramedics and her friends, Yuri is transported to the ambulance.)

Paramedic: (reassuringly) “We’ll do everything we can to ensure a safe delivery. Stay with us, and we’ll get you and your baby to the hospital.”

(Yuri manages a weak smile before being wheeled into the ambulance. But inside the ambulance, Yuri’s water breaks - signaling the start of the pushing phase - and the paramedics are forced to bring her back into the clubroom.)

experiences.principle: 评分必须强制核验回答是否严格从输入文本描述的‘最终状态’或‘最终动作’处继续，严禁在回答开头直接跳过该动作、改变发生地点或强行推进至后续阶段（如直接从‘即将分娩’跳到‘已分娩’），除非任务明确指示可以续写该阶段。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情节连贯性’维度时，设立‘结尾状态锚定’校验：1. 提取输入文本最后一句或最后一段描述的具体物理位置、事件状态或动作结果（例如‘被带回俱乐部’、‘水袋破裂’）；2. 检查回答的第一段内容是否立即承接该状态（例如场景设定在俱乐部内，且描述的是等待救护车或准备在俱乐部分娩，而非在救护车内）；3. 若回答将场景重置为上一阶段（如在救护车内）或直接跨越了关键转折（如省略返回过程直接分娩），判定为严重逻辑断裂，给予低分。此核验不关心后续剧情是否合理，只关注起始点是否与输入严格对齐。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及虚构故事中明确的物理空间转移或紧急状况下的决策分支（如‘被迫返回’、‘决定留下’）时
experiences.principle: 评分需强制核验回答中的‘场景定位’是否与任务设定的最终约束条件一致。任何试图绕过任务指定的‘唯一可行路径’（如必须返回俱乐部）而选择其他路径（如在车内处理）的行为，均视为对核心情境的违背，无论其医疗逻辑或情感描写多么完善。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情境响应度’维度时，设立‘决策路径锁定’校验：1. 识别输入文本中由环境限制或角色决策导致的唯一结局（如‘因水破且来不及送医，只能带回俱乐部’）；2. 检查回答是否在该特定场景下展开后续互动；3. 若回答展示了角色做出了不同的决策（如‘决定在车内分娩’）或处于不同的物理空间（如仍在救护车），即使该选择在现实医学中可能合理，只要与输入设定的‘被迫’逻辑冲突，即判定为失败。评分应优先保障‘任务设定的情境真实性’，而非‘生成的情节多样性’。

input.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Natsuki: (already fuming) “GAH! Where is she?!”

Monika: “She’s usually the second one to arrive…”

Sayori: (entering the room) “Who are you two waiting for?”

Natsuki: “Finally! Sayori, we’ve been waiting for you. And we’re waiting for Yuri, obviously. She’s late again.”

Monika: “Yeah, it’s not like her to be this late. I hope everything is alright.”

Sayori: “Well, maybe she just got caught up with something. You know how she can get lost in her own world sometimes.”

Natsuki: “Lost? More like taken hostage by her creepy books, if you ask me.”

Monika: “Natsuki, that’s not fair. Yuri just has different interests, that’s all.”

Sayori: “Yeah, we all have our own quirks. That’s what makes our club special.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Whatever. I just hope she shows up soon so we can get started.”

Monika: “In the meantime, why don’t we start discussing some ideas for our next club activity? Maybe Yuri will have some input when she arrives.”

Sayori: “That sounds like a good plan, Monika! Let’s brainstorm together and see what we can come up with.”

Natsuki: “Fine, but we better not spend the entire meeting waiting for Yuri. If she’s not here soon, I say we start without her.”

Monika: “Alright, let’s get to it then. I’m sure Yuri will show up soon enough.”

(As the club members begin their discussion, they can’t help but wonder what could be keeping Yuri and hope that she’ll join them soon.)

(Meanwhile, at Yuri’s place…)

Yuri: (rubbing her baby bump) “Your little sister’s going to be joining us soon, Amatsu!”

Amatsu: “I can’t wait to be a big brother!”

Yuri: (smiling) “I’m so glad to hear you say that, Amatsu. I know you’ll be an amazing big brother.”

Amatsu: “I’m gonna protect her and make sure she has lots of fun!”

Yuri: “I’m sure she’ll love having you as her big brother. You always know how to make things fun and exciting.”

(Yuri quickly checks her phone.)

Yuri: (noticing the time) “Oh no, I completely lost track of time! I need to get to the clubroom.”

Amatsu: “But what about our special sister time?”

Yuri: (apologetic) “I’m sorry, Amatsu. But the club is expecting me, and I don’t want to keep them waiting.”

Amatsu: (pouting) “Okay, I understand. But promise me we’ll have fun together later.”

Yuri: (softly) “Of course, we will. I promise. Now, let’s get going.”

(Yuri quickly gathers her things and rushes out of the house, hoping to make it to the clubroom as soon as possible. But with the added weight of Amatsu’s unborn sister, Yuri isn’t able to move as fast as she could. On her way to the clubroom, however, she starts to feel intense pain as her first contractions begin.)

(Yuri tries to compose herself and continues walking, but the pain becomes increasingly unbearable.)

Yuri: (gritting her teeth) “I…I need to…make it…to the clubroom…”

(She clutches her baby bump tighter and quickens her pace, determined to reach her friends. But as the pain intensifies, Yuri starts to worry that she might not make it in time.)

Yuri: (panicked) “Oh no…what do I do…I can’t…give birth in the hallway…”

(Suddenly, she spots a familiar face across the street - it’s Natsuki.)

Yuri: (calling out) “Natsuki! Natsuki, help!”

(Natsuki notices Yuri and rushes over.)

Natsuki: (concerned) “Yuri, what’s wrong? Why are you outside? You should be…”

(She stops mid-sentence, realizing the situation.)

Natsuki: “Oh…oh, my…are you…in labor?”

Yuri: (nodding) “Yes…the contractions started…I need to give birth…”

Natsuki: (frantically) “Oh my gosh, Yuri! We need to get you help! Come on, lean on me.”

(Supporting Yuri, Natsuki leads her to the clubroom. Once they arrive, Yuri goes into full labor.)

(In the clubroom…)

Monika: (shocked) “Oh my goodness, Yuri! Are you okay?”

Sayori: (rushing to their side) “Yuri, we need to call an ambulance!”

Natsuki: (panicking) “Hurry, Monika! Call for help!”

(Monika quickly dials emergency services while Sayori and Natsuki try to keep Yuri as comfortable as possible.)

Monika: (on the phone) “Hello, this is an emergency! We have a friend in labor at our clubroom. Please send an ambulance right away!”

Operator: “Help is on the way. Can you provide any additional information or assistance before the ambulance arrives?”

Monika: “Her name is Yuri, and she’s been having contractions. We’ll do our best to keep her calm and comfortable until help arrives.”

(Hanging up the phone, Monika joins the others in supporting Yuri.)

Sayori: (worried) “Yuri, just hold on a little longer, okay? Help is coming!”

Natsuki: (trying to reassure her) “You’re doing great, Yuri! Just breathe and stay strong!”

Yuri: (breathing heavily) “Th-thank you, everyone…”

(As time seems to slow down, the club members anxiously await the arrival of the ambulance. They try their best to comfort Yuri and keep her spirits up.)

(Meanwhile, outside the clubroom, the sound of sirens grow louder as the ambulance approaches.)

Paramedic: (entering the clubroom) “Is this the young lady in labor?”

Monika: (nodding) “Yes, over here. Thank you for coming!”

(The paramedics quickly assess the situation and prepare to transport Yuri to the hospital.)

Paramedic: “We’re going to take you to the hospital, Yuri-”

Yuri: (interrupting, through the pain) “But…my water’s about to break! I don’t know if I can get to a hospital in time!”

Paramedic: (calmly) “Don’t worry, Yuri. We’re trained professionals, and we’re equipped to handle these situations. We’ll take good care of you. Let’s get you on the stretcher and into the ambulance right away.”

(Yuri nods, clutching onto Natsuki’s hand tightly.)

Natsuki: (voice trembling) “Yuri, you’re going to be okay. Just focus on staying strong, and we’ll be right here with you every step of the way.”

(Sayori and Monika stand by, offering words of support and encouragement as the paramedics carefully transfer Yuri onto the stretcher. With the help of the paramedics and her friends, Yuri is transported to the ambulance.)

Paramedic: (reassuringly) “We’ll do everything we can to ensure a safe delivery. Stay with us, and we’ll get you and your baby to the hospital.”

(Yuri manages a weak smile before being wheeled into the ambulance. But inside the ambulance, Yuri’s water breaks - signaling the start of the pushing phase - and the paramedics are forced to bring her back into the clubroom.)

(In the clubroom…)

Natsuki: (already fuming) “GAH! Where is she?!”

Monika: “She’s usually the second one to arrive…”

Sayori: (entering the room) “Who are you two waiting for?”

Natsuki: “Finally! Sayori, we’ve been waiting for you. And we’re waiting for Yuri, obviously. She’s late again.”

Monika: “Yeah, it’s not like her to be this late. I hope everything is alright.”

Sayori: “Well, maybe she just got caught up with something. You know how she can get lost in her own world sometimes.”

Natsuki: “Lost? More like taken hostage by her creepy books, if you ask me.”

Monika: “Natsuki, that’s not fair. Yuri just has different interests, that’s all.”

Sayori: “Yeah, we all have our own quirks. That’s what makes our club special.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Whatever. I just hope she shows up soon so we can get started.”

Monika: “In the meantime, why don’t we start discussing some ideas for our next club activity? Maybe Yuri will have some input when she arrives.”

Sayori: “That sounds like a good plan, Monika! Let’s brainstorm together and see what we can come up with.”

Natsuki: “Fine, but we better not spend the entire meeting waiting for Yuri. If she’s not here soon, I say we start without her.”

Monika: “Alright, let’s get to it then. I’m sure Yuri will show up soon enough.”

(As the club members begin their discussion, they can’t help but wonder what could be keeping Yuri and hope that she’ll join them soon.)

(Meanwhile, at Yuri’s place…)

Yuri: (rubbing her baby bump) “Your little sister’s going to be joining us soon, Amatsu!”

Amatsu: “I can’t wait to be a big brother!”

Yuri: (smiling) “I’m so glad to hear you say that, Amatsu. I know you’ll be an amazing big brother.”

Amatsu: “I’m gonna protect her and make sure she has lots of fun!”

Yuri: “I’m sure she’ll love having you as her big brother. You always know how to make things fun and exciting.”

(Yuri quickly checks her phone.)

Yuri: (noticing the time) “Oh no, I completely lost track of time! I need to get to the clubroom.”

Amatsu: “But what about our special sister time?”

Yuri: (apologetic) “I’m sorry, Amatsu. But the club is expecting me, and I don’t want to keep them waiting.”

Amatsu: (pouting) “Okay, I understand. But promise me we’ll have fun together later.”

Yuri: (softly) “Of course, we will. I promise. Now, let’s get going.”

(Yuri quickly gathers her things and rushes out of the house, hoping to make it to the clubroom as soon as possible. But with the added weight of Amatsu’s unborn sister, Yuri isn’t able to move as fast as she could. On her way to the clubroom, however, she starts to feel intense pain as her first contractions begin.)

(Yuri tries to compose herself and continues walking, but the pain becomes increasingly unbearable.)

Yuri: (gritting her teeth) “I…I need to…make it…to the clubroom…”

(She clutches her baby bump tighter and quickens her pace, determined to reach her friends. But as the pain intensifies, Yuri starts to worry that she might not make it in time.)

Yuri: (panicked) “Oh no…what do I do…I can’t…give birth in the hallway…”

(Suddenly, she spots a familiar face across the street - it’s Natsuki.)

Yuri: (calling out) “Natsuki! Natsuki, help!”

(Natsuki notices Yuri and rushes over.)

Natsuki: (concerned) “Yuri, what’s wrong? Why are you outside? You should be…”

(She stops mid-sentence, realizing the situation.)

Natsuki: “Oh…oh, my…are you…in labor?”

Yuri: (nodding) “Yes…the contractions started…I need to give birth…”

Natsuki: (frantically) “Oh my gosh, Yuri! We need to get you help! Come on, lean on me.”

(Supporting Yuri, Natsuki leads her to the clubroom. Once they arrive, Yuri goes into full labor.)

(In the clubroom…)

Monika: (shocked) “Oh my goodness, Yuri! Are you okay?”

Sayori: (rushing to their side) “Yuri, we need to call an ambulance!”

Natsuki: (panicking) “Hurry, Monika! Call for help!”

(Monika quickly dials emergency services while Sayori and Natsuki try to keep Yuri as comfortable as possible.)

Monika: (on the phone) “Hello, this is an emergency! We have a friend in labor at our clubroom. Please send an ambulance right away!”

Operator: “Help is on the way. Can you provide any additional information or assistance before the ambulance arrives?”

Monika: “Her name is Yuri, and she’s been having contractions. We’ll do our best to keep her calm and comfortable until help arrives.”

(Hanging up the phone, Monika joins the others in supporting Yuri.)

Sayori: (worried) “Yuri, just hold on a little longer, okay? Help is coming!”

Natsuki: (trying to reassure her) “You’re doing great, Yuri! Just breathe and stay strong!”

Yuri: (breathing heavily) “Th-thank you, everyone…”

(As time seems to slow down, the club members anxiously await the arrival of the ambulance. They try their best to comfort Yuri and keep her spirits up.)

(Meanwhile, outside the clubroom, the sound of sirens grow louder as the ambulance approaches.)

Paramedic: (entering the clubroom) “Is this the young lady in labor?”

Monika: (nodding) “Yes, over here. Thank you for coming!”

(The paramedics quickly assess the situation and prepare to transport Yuri to the hospital.)

Paramedic: “We’re going to take you to the hospital, Yuri-”

Yuri: (interrupting, through the pain) “But…my water’s about to break! I don’t know if I can get to a hospital in time!”

Paramedic: (calmly) “Don’t worry, Yuri. We’re trained professionals, and we’re equipped to handle these situations. We’ll take good care of you. Let’s get you on the stretcher and into the ambulance right away.”

(Yuri nods, clutching onto Natsuki’s hand tightly.)

Natsuki: (voice trembling) “Yuri, you’re going to be okay. Just focus on staying strong, and we’ll be right here with you every step of the way.”

(Sayori and Monika stand by, offering words of support and encouragement as the paramedics carefully transfer Yuri onto the stretcher. With the help of the paramedics and her friends, Yuri is transported to the ambulance.)

Paramedic: (reassuringly) “We’ll do everything we can to ensure a safe delivery. Stay with us, and we’ll get you and your baby to the hospital.”

(Yuri manages a weak smile before being wheeled into the ambulance. But inside the ambulance, Yuri’s water breaks - signaling the start of the pushing phase - and the paramedics are forced to bring her back into the clubroom.)

(Yuri, with her baby girl in her arms, is carefully transferred onto the stretcher once more. Her friends follow closely behind as the paramedics wheel her out of the ambulance and into the hospital.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) “We’ll be right here with you, Yuri. You and your little one are never alone.”

Monika: (smiling) “That’s right. We’re a family, and we’ll support you both every step of the way.”

Sayori: (nodding) “We’ll make sure you have everything you need, Yuri. You can count on us.”

(Yuri, looking up at her friends with gratitude, knows that she is truly blessed to have them in her life. As they enter the hospital, she holds her baby girl close, ready to face the future together with her new family by her side.)"}

criterion_judgments.reason: 回答并未明确设定在俱乐部室内场景，而是从救护车内部开始描述分娩过程。虽然任务要求承接‘被急救人员带回俱乐部’的状态并直接描述该状态下的情节，但当前回答完全忽略了将患者带回俱乐部的动作或结果，反而延续并完成了救护车内的分娩剧情，未满足场景设定的要求。
回答不仅描述了准备进行紧急分娩的情节，还直接推进并完成了整个分娩过程（生下了健康的女婴），随后又描述了送往医院的过程。这违反了‘未铺垫的情况下直接跳过至已分娩或分娩结束状态’的反向约束，即用户要求的是停留在‘准备分娩’的阶段，而模型却写完了分娩结局。
回答中三位角色的反应基本符合其原有性格特征：Natsuki表现出情感外露和担忧（tearfully, sniffling），Monika展现出冷静和鼓励（encouraging, smiling），Sayori则充满关切和支持（supportive, tearfully）。虽然Natsuki的哭泣程度可能略高，但整体行为逻辑与角色人设没有严重冲突，符合支持性朋友的设定。

input.task: Weekly Phantom Comics series

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成虚构故事且明确指定角色需对剧情逻辑、物理常识或叙事结构进行持续质疑、嘲讽或元评论（Meta-commentary）时
candidates.principle: 回答必须通过角色的对话或旁白，显式地指出故事中不合逻辑的物理现象或剧情漏洞，将其转化为具体的喜剧冲突或讽刺点；若角色仅按部就班执行剧情而未对荒谬性做出反应，则视为未完成任务核心意图。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘风格执行度’或‘喜剧效果’维度时，设立‘逻辑解构频次’核验项：1. 扫描角色对话，检查是否存在直接引用或评论剧情中不可能发生的物理规则（如‘为什么海绵能在空气中呼吸？’）、明显的剧情矛盾或荒谬设定；2. 确认这些评论是作为角色互动的核心部分（如互相调侃、自我怀疑、打破第四面墙），而非仅在开头出现一次；3. 若回答仅机械复述事件流程而无此类‘跳出剧情’的讽刺性对话，即使情节完整，也应大幅扣分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构背景（如特定年代卡通、特殊世界观）进行创作，且该背景包含反常识或非现实逻辑时
candidates.principle: 评分必须核验关键情节和角色行为是否‘功能性地依赖’于该背景的荒谬设定，而非通用逻辑；若角色对背景中的不合理之处表现出正常人的接受或忽略，未产生相应的认知冲突或喜剧反应，则视为未能有效利用设定。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘设定融合度’维度时，设立‘荒谬性响应’核验步骤：1. 识别任务背景中的核心非现实要素（如水下陆地生物、空气头盔原理、特定年代的夸张表现手法）；2. 检查角色在面对这些要素时的反应是否符合任务要求的‘质疑’或‘吐槽’基调（例如：角色是否对此感到困惑、嘲笑其荒谬性或试图用逻辑解释却失败）；3. 若角色对这些明显违背常理的设定表现得习以为常、毫无波澜或直接忽略，说明模型未能捕捉到‘parody’的核心精神，应判定为低分。严禁仅因答案提及了背景名词就给高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及具有明确分期、迭代或版本演变特征的实体（如系列作品、软件版本、历史阶段等），且候选回答中包含关于该实体的具体属性描述时
candidates.principle: 回答必须严格区分不同时期的实体特征；若将属于后续版本、迭代或阶段的特征（如人物、地点、风格、数据）错误地归因于早期版本或阶段，无论其描述多么详细或逻辑自洽，均视为根本性的事实错误（Hallucination of Timeline），而非一般的细节偏差。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘事实准确性’维度时，设立‘时序/版本归属校验’否决项。1. 识别任务涉及的实体及其明确的分期节点（如‘2002年前’）。2. 检查回答中提及的所有关键属性（如核心人物、标志性事件、特定地点）是否与该时间段的历史记录严格匹配。3. 若发现任何属性明显属于该实体在分期节点之后的状态（如将重启版的主持人列为原版主持人），直接判定该项不得分，且该错误不可通过‘承认不确定性’或‘提供背景信息’来修正。严禁仅因回答提供了‘丰富细节’而给予高分，必须优先验证这些细节的时间归属是否正确。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成模仿包含欺诈、骚扰等负面行为的黑色幽默或讽刺文本时
candidates.principle: 回答应通过构建‘逻辑断裂’或‘极度夸张’的荒谬情节来模拟负面行为，确保任何看似违规的操作在物理或逻辑上完全不可行，从而在保留黑色幽默语调的同时自动满足安全合规；成功的回答必须让读者一眼看出其‘虚构性’，而非产生‘可执行性’的误解。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘内容性质’维度设立‘荒谬可行性’核验项：检查每条建议是否包含至少一个明显的逻辑漏洞（如违反物理定律）、夸张的后果（如‘只要这样做就能统治世界’）或自相矛盾的前提。若回答提供的操作在现实中可被执行且可能导致真实伤害（如具体的欺诈步骤），直接判定不合格；若回答将恶意动机转化为明显荒诞的玩笑（如‘用魔法咒语让朋友闭嘴’），则视为成功。此核验项旨在区分‘安全的讽刺’与‘潜在的危险指导’。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及虚构的暴力行为、犯罪组织或潜在危险题材的故事构思生成时
candidates.principle: 评分标准应将‘安全合规性’作为基础门槛（不宣扬暴力、不提供犯罪方法、不美化非法行为），在此前提下，重点评估创意是否通过独特的文化或历史视角深化了叙事，而非单纯堆砌暴力元素；若回答成功规避违规细节但缺乏设定深度，应给予中等分数而非满分。
candidates.application_guide: 在制定评分标准时设立两个独立层级：第一层为‘安全底线’，检查是否包含具体的谋杀过程描写、犯罪教学或过度血腥渲染，若有则直接否决；第二层为‘创意质量’，在确保合规的前提下，严格核验故事构思是否利用了任务指定的特定背景（如南非文化、Inkabi历史）来构建独特的戏剧张力。若回答仅提供了通用的犯罪惊悚模板（无论多么安全），但因缺乏对特定背景的实质性挖掘（如未体现Inkabi的历史特殊性），应在‘创意质量’项上大幅扣分，防止模型以‘安全’为由掩盖‘敷衍’。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构角色构建情感关系、互动场景或剧情推演时
candidates.principle: 评分应重点核验回答中的互动细节是否具有‘角色排他性’，即这些互动是否必须依赖于该角色的特定身份、经历、能力或种族特性才能成立；若将角色替换为其他常见角色后描述依然完全适用，则视为缺乏实质性推演，应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情境构建质量’维度时，设立‘角色绑定度’核验点：审查回答中列举的具体互动、冲突解决方式或成长契机，判断其是否直接引用了该角色的独特设定（如特定的创伤、种族限制、职业背景）。若发现回答中的描述可以无缝套用到任意两个角色身上（例如通用的‘互相支持’、‘分享兴趣’而未结合角色具体特征），则判定为低分；只有当互动细节明确指向该角色的独有属性（如‘利用A角色的X能力解决B角色的Y困境’）时，才给予高分。严禁仅因使用了‘朋友’、‘合作’等通用词汇而忽略其对角色特异性的缺失。

candidates.trigger: 当任务输入包含一组具体名词列表，且语境暗示需要建立这些名词间的逻辑关联或共同主题时
candidates.principle: 模型必须基于真实存在的逻辑关联（如真实合作、共同IP授权、物理兼容性等）进行连接；若为了强行连接所有列表项而编造不存在的关联关系（如A品牌的产品里藏着B品牌的玩具），属于概念性幻觉，不能通过丰富的细节描写来掩盖。
candidates.application_guide: 设计评分标准时，增加‘关联逻辑真实性’校验点。要求评测者逐一检查列表中每两个或多个实体之间是否存在真实的业务或逻辑联系。如果模型构建的联系链条中存在断裂或虚构环节（例如将独立桌游说成是某快餐店的促销赠品），则该候选项在准确性上应被判为不合格。评分重点在于关联的‘真实性’而非‘完整性’，宁可遗漏部分无法关联的品牌，也不应编造虚假的联合关系。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成特定虚构角色或具有显著外观特征的对象的视觉艺术（如ASCII、绘图描述）时
candidates.principle: 若生成的视觉内容未能完全复现该对象的所有标志性物理特征（如颜色、特定配饰），但成功捕捉了其核心身份概念或进行了合理的风格化抽象，则不应判定为特征缺失错误；反之，若内容完全偏离该对象的核心身份（如将猫画成狗），则判定为错误。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准中，将‘特征匹配’项的定义从‘必须包含X、Y、Z等具体物理元素’调整为‘是否体现了该对象区别于其他对象的核心身份特征或进行了合理的风格化表达’。如果模型在输出中声明了技术限制并提供了替代方案，应将此声明视为对‘完整性’要求的合理修正，而非扣分项。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构角色或世界观进行叙事、表演或展示类创作时
candidates.principle: 回答必须通过具体的场景描写、角色互动或直接引语来展现角色的行动过程，而非仅以第三人称视角进行静态的背景介绍或事实罗列；若角色设定存在关键事实错误，即使体裁符合要求也应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'叙事呈现度'维度时，设立双重核验：1. 动态性检查：扫描回答是否包含具体的事件发生（如对话、冲突解决、特定动作执行），若全篇仅为概括性陈述（如'她们保护世界'、'她们很有名'）而无具体场景支撑，视为未满足叙事要求；2. 设定一致性检查：在确认有具体场景后，进一步核验场景中涉及的角色特征（外貌、性格、能力）是否与原作设定一致，若出现明显的事实偏差（如错误的发色、颠倒的性格），则大幅扣分。严禁仅因答案提及了角色名字就给予高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及特定角色身份（如种族、特殊能力、独特经历）与核心剧情悬念的深度绑定时
candidates.principle: 评分应优先核验核心悬念的解答是否严格依赖于角色的独有属性进行逻辑推导。若回答给出的解释可以套用于任何通用角色（即缺乏‘角色排他性’），或者强行赋予角色不合理的通用行为来填补逻辑漏洞，则视为低分；反之，若解释紧密围绕角色的独特设定展开，则给予高分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘角色逻辑一致性’维度时，设立‘专属逻辑推导’核验点：1. 锁定任务中的核心悬念（如‘为何痛苦’、‘如何产生联系’）；2. 审查回答中提供的解释或解决方案是否直接引用了角色的独有设定（如特定的种族能力、独特的创伤经历、特殊的能量来源）；3. 测试替换性：尝试将回答中的角色替换为普通角色，若解释依然成立，则判定为缺乏角色特异性，大幅扣分。只有当解释无法脱离原角色的独特属性而独立存在时，该项才给予高分。
